mapper.select: SELECT sa.clazz_id AS clazzId, count(sa.id) as arrangeCount, GROUP_CONCAT('(' || scs.`name` || '/' || st.`name` || ')') as arrangeNameList FROM sys_arrange sa LEFT JOIN sys_clazz sc ON sa.clazz_id = sc.id LEFT JOIN sys_course scs ON sa.course_id = scs.id LEFT JOIN sys_teacher st ON sa.teacher_id = st.id GROUP BY sa.clazz_id
